images.title: Stephen McKay / Big Wood, Thetford Forest
images.caption: Big Wood, Thetford Forest. A group of walkers head along this forest walk leading away from Lynford Stag picnic site towards Lynford Hall. Thetford Forest is the largest lowland pine forest in Britain, started in the 1920s as a strategic timber reserve on the Breckland heaths which were of little agricultural value.

description: This circular walk explores the Lynford Stag Walk in Thetford Forest. The trail starts from the Lynford Stag car park where there's a nice picnic area and the metal imitation "target stag", found by the workers when the area was being planted. From the car park you can pick up a pleasant circular trail taking you through the peaceful woodland. The area is popular with dog walkers. About a mile to the north you could extend your walk at the Lynford Arboretum where there's another circular trail and some fine specimen trees.
